method: SEC Form 13F holdings in each quarter's data set, latest restatement; long shares only, no options. Managers that filed for both quarters, except those whose table in SEC's data set is incomplete (rows below 90% of the entries declared). Shares as filed for the quarter; the earlier quarter is put on the same basis for splits in between. Value = shares x the median price per share the filers report. A position whose value per share is more than 2x from that price (in dollars or thousands), or whose shares were restated for a split after the quarter, is left out of both quarters and counted. Facts, not a signal.
